newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CS FIRST BOSTON MAINTAINS BUY ON MEZOGEP.
newsitem.headline: CS FIRST BOSTON MAINTAINS BUY ON MEZOGEP.

text.p: CS First Boston said on Monday it maintained its buy recommendation on shares in Hungarian machinery company Mezogep Rt after its first half earnings.

"New orders pushed agro exports up by 148 percent and auto exports by 59 percent in the first half 1997," Pal Bogar, analyst at CS First Boston, said in a company report. "Total sales grew by 86 percent.
"Gross margins increased from 31 percent to 35 percent and net margins (excluding extraordinary items) from 15 percent to 21 percent," he said. "We reiterate our buy recommendation."

Mezogep released its first half earnings on Monday, and reported its operating profits rising to 579 million forints from 282 million, while its sales surged to 3.404 billion forints from 1.830 billion forints.
On a tumbling market on Monday Mezogep shares finished unchanged at 4,400 forints. The BUX index finished at 7,861.88 points, down 485.64 points or 5.82 percent.
